summary_1line: After Dasaratha’s sacrifice, Rama, Bharata, Lakshmana, and Shatrughna are born, grow in virtue and skill, and the sage Vishwamitra arrives at the court.

image_candidates.scene_text: Queen Kaushalya gazes at the newborn Rama as celestial beings shower flowers and musicians play in the sky above Ayodhya.
Young Rama rides out on horseback for the hunt while Lakshmana follows closely behind with bow and arrows, guarding his brother.
King Dasaratha and sage Vasishtha welcome the radiant ascetic Vishwamitra at the palace gate with offerings and reverence.
